title: Mirror with Four Bixie
culture: China, Southern and Northern Dynasties period (386-589)
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
I made the bright mirror, 
Having melted three metals.
I have sculpted the classic paradigms 
And the virtuous in myriad years.
The human spirit is made manifest
And heavenly deities reveal their noble forms.
As they are painted with six colors,
Their light shines through the heaven and earth.
With virtues and the Way in grasp,
Rules and laws sprang into being....
